payload.title: BUG: the windows-gnu lane runs wine 9.0 while the local loop runs wine 11.16, and the two disagree
BUG: two byte-identical headings make both sections permanently unaddressable, and the error's prescribed remedy names parameters that do not exist on the tool it names
BUG: OP-4's path~/.claude predicate can never fire against a real write response
BUG: workspace(post_compact) flushes LSP without prewarming, so the next navigation call pays cold start and can blow the 60s tool timeout — while its own hint promises no disruption
BUG: a rendezvous slot that misses its SessionStart stamp can never be stamped again, so Phase C stays inactive for the life of that server
BUG: Triggered operator rules route nothing in production — no non-librarian tool ever supplies a selector_key
BUG: project-root .env carried multiple stale desktop-machine values, silently masked by ambient shell/MCP env
BUG: the working tree briefly held a mutation nobody applied, during the window announcing that exact mutation
BUG: an archived bug file records a worktree deletion, with reclaimed-MB figures, that never happened on this machine
BUG: core.hooksPath points at the pre-rename repo path, so no git hook runs in this checkout
BUG: ListAgents omits live cross-profile sessions writing the same checkout, and reports the short count as complete
BUG: a peer's lean build clobbers target/debug/codescout, reddening 10 cli_artifact tests with a gating-regression message
A doctor test substring-matches a random tempdir name, so it reds CI at roughly 1-in-800
BUG: one stray ``` disables every line-anchored field for the REST of the file, and doctor reports the result as "none declared"
BUG: librarian-runtime guide denies the augmentation sidecar — the same-day corrective sweep named three places and this was the fourth
BUG: library is gated on having a library registered, and it is the only tool that can register one
